title: Authentication and Authorization knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Authentication and Authorization”?
options: It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring.
It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
questions.answer_key: A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring.
